title: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash 模型
summary: DeepSeek 在 Twitter 和 Hugging Face 上发布了 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 模型。该消息在 Hacker News 上获得 482 分和 261 条评论，引发广泛关注。作为 DeepSeek V4 系列的轻量级版本，Flash 通常意味着更快的推理速度和更低的计算成本，适合对延迟敏感或资源受限的场景。模型已在 Hugging Face 开源，便于开发者直接下载和部署。虽然具体技术细节尚未完全披露，但结合 DeepSeek 此前在 MoE 架构和高效推理方面的积累，V4.1 Flash 有望在保持较强性能的同时显著提升效率。该发布进一步丰富了开源大模型生态，为社区提供了新的高效选择，并可能推动实时应用和边缘部署的发展。
summary_en: DeepSeek has released the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model on Twitter and Hugging Face. The announcement gained significant attention on Hacker News with 482 points and 261 comments. As a lightweight variant of the DeepSeek V4 series, Flash typically implies faster inference and lower computational cost, making it suitable for latency-sensitive or resource-constrained scenarios. The model is open-sourced on Hugging Face, allowing developers to download and deploy it directly. While specific technical details are not fully disclosed, building on DeepSeek's prior work in MoE architectures and efficient inference, V4.1 Flash is expected to deliver strong performance with improved efficiency. This release further enriches the open-source LLM ecosystem, offering the community a new efficient option and potentially advancing real-time applications and edge deployment.
